maria.g: FYI: after last night's KMS rekey we started seeing intermittent SCIM 500s for a handful of Okta customers. :eyes:
ajay.s: When did the errors start? any common customer/profile?
maria.g: around 23:45 UTC. affected tenants are all using service-account provisioning (externalId) + RBAC role renames last week.
kevin_l: logs from provisioning service: `error=\"kms: decrypt failed: invalid key version\"` and `scim: failed to map externalId: malformed JWE`
idp-admin: That malformed JWE suggests we have encrypted external_id blobs created with the old KMS key format. Did the re-encrypt job complete for the provisioning DB?
maria.g: re-encrypt job ran, but it errored on ~2% of rows with timeout on KMS requests. We retried but didn't notice the rate-limited failures.
ajay.s: Can you paste the minimal stack trace?
maria.g: ```
2026-03-20T23:46:02Z svc/provisioner auth.go:142: decrypt external_id failed: kms.Decrypt error: NotFoundException key id not found
2026-03-20T23:46:02Z svc/provisioner scim.go:87: apply patch -> 500 internal: malformed external_id JWE
```
kevin_l: Quick mitigation: we can fallback to the old key via rotation alias if available, or unfreeze the re-encrypt job and requeue the failed row ids. For customers in-flight, we should return 429 instead of 500 to avoid SCIM retries spamming the IdP.
idp-admin: We can return 429, but Okta will still retry; better to gate the SCIM patch apply with a healthcheck that marks provisioner degraded and pauses delta pushes until fix. :+1:
ajay.s: Root cause timeline hypothesis: role rename changed mapping that caused re-evaluation of externalId canonicalization. Some rows hit the re-encrypt path (old cipher text) which called KMS with a dead key version -> decrypt failed -> we didn't catch and left ciphertext unchanged -> later code path tried to interpret as plaintext and produced malformed JWE.
maria.g: sounds plausible. Also saw `rbac/audit` entries where the role id changed but `external_id` still references old role slug. audit logs show deltas at 23:30 that correspond.
kevin_l: Action items: 1) Pause SCIM delta pushes for affected tenants (temp gate). 2) Requeue failed re-encrypt rows with exponential backoff and increased KMS quota. 3) Add defensive handling: if decrypt fails, return 429 and log remediation ticket id. 4) Backfill audit entries to show which external_id blobs were rekeyed.
ajay.s: I'll open an incident ticket and set severity to P2. assign to infra-crypto and identity teams.
idp-admin: Quick query to get affected IDs: `SELECT id FROM provisioning WHERE external_id LIKE 'jwe:%' AND reencrypt_status='failed' LIMIT 1000;`
maria.g: running now, returning ~240 rows across 6 tenants.
kevin_l: For immediate customer communication, we should tell them: "We identified provisioning failures after a KMS rotation that affected a subset of SCIM updates. We're pausing deltas and replaying a targeted re-encrypt; no user data was exposed. Ops will follow up when deltas resume."
ajay.s: Also need to update runbook: add step to monitor KMS throttling during rekey and mark rows for manual retry. Current runbook assumes all rows succeed.
idp-admin: One gotcha: if service-account token used for SCIM has shortened TTL, replays might fail. Confirm tokens are still valid for the tenants before retrying.
maria.g: verified tokens are valid. requeue started (job id rj-20260321-01).
kevin_l: After requeue, add a check to the re-encrypt job to verify ciphertext version header `v=` and skip rows where header missing -> surface them for manual triage (don't try blind decrypt).
ajay.s: Good. I'll coordinate comms and postmortem. assign to: @kevin_l, @maria.g, infra-crypto.
maria.g: thanks. will follow up with remediation playbook and diff for the runbook. :thumbsup:
